title: Self-healing X13: the orchestrator agent diagnoses from an evidence index and writes a typed diagnosis.json; it dispatches nothing
summary: The orchestrator agent is an isolated worker (ADR-0154). It reads an evidence index lazily and writes one declared artifact with one action from the closed catalog. Spec: docs/architecture/llm-isolation.md §17.1, §18.3 and §18.4.
fix: Add the orchestrator-agent persona and profile with no dispatch tool, the evidence index (classes incident, signal, digest, retrospective, lesson, ci-log, diff) in the X5 format, and the evolve.diagnosis/1 schema in phasecontract. Route the seat through cliroute as a named agent.
acceptance: RED first: a diagnosis with an action outside the catalog passes the parse today; after the change the schema refuses it
Each evidence id in a diagnosis must exist in the index
The profile has no tool that starts an agent or an evolve dispatch; matrix row N3 and N4 hold for this seat
A low-confidence diagnosis maps to halt-and-escalate
